ctaHeading: Need Truck Body Work in Sunshine? Let's Talk.
aboutText: At MVP Truck Bodies in Sunshine, our experienced team has been delivering precision steel fabrication for years. We specialise in brand-new refrigerated bodies, tray rebuilds, and full truck repairs. Every vehicle that rolls through our doors receives top-quality craftsmanship, competitive pricing, and a commitment to getting your fleet back on the road fast. Serving Sunshine and surrounding areas, we pride ourselves on reliability and excellence in every project.
servicesText: We offer a comprehensive range of truck body services, from custom builds to complete overhauls. Our team handles refrigerated bodies, tray rebuilds, repairs, and maintenance with precision. Whatever your truck needs, we deliver quality fabrication tailored to your business.
